dataset.smoke_batch: all 17 torque rows plus first 239 SHA-sorted preservation rows

objective.action: class-balanced MSE against torque-only final targets
objective.hidden: unweighted MSE on frozen source h_out
objective.trainable: all actor leaves except scale_logits kernel and bias

optimizer.acceptance: Armijo decrease with fixed conventional fraction 1e-4

pass_rule.corrected_ratio: <=0.95 after two updates on smoke and full datasets
pass_rule.exports: step 0 and 2 stateful ONNX contracts both pass
pass_rule.hidden_mse: <=0.01 times corrected baseline MSE on smoke and full
pass_rule.leaves: every non-scale actor leaf changes; scale logits stay exact
pass_rule.loss: total and action losses strictly decrease
pass_rule.preservation_ratio: <=0.01 on smoke and all 4,783 preservation rows

selection.causal_evidence: V142 showed that the V140 direction repaired the labeled startup knee but transferred closed-loop load to the mature right ankle
selection.mechanical_change: only torque-projected rows retain oracle targets; every supreme-only and unchanged row targets the source action
selection.teacher: V131 exact common-safe two-fit oracle traces

stop_rule: if any check fails, close this exact torque-only actor formulation; do not tune the optimizer, target population, class weight, number of updates, or pass thresholds
